race.comment: FREDERICK (3) held his ground when first up but he never has produced any sort of form when doing that in the past. He could easily bounce off that now fitter. Should take up a position and be hard to get by. IT'S GNARLY (4) was better again at Bendigo and that form should hold up well into this. He went forward there and only the gate poses more issues. EPICUS (10) went to a weak race and got a confidence building win on the board. However the form prior at Cranbourne was good enough for this sort of event. MONT SAINT MICHEL (5) always gives away a start but does finish off. It does look to be a likely scenario again. ZE BEE NINE (8) can get a charmed run in transit off the barrier. Has raced well here in the past.
